name: @yukhyshell5/pythia
description: Turns incomprehensible bytecode into equally incomprehensible DOT graphs. But hey, at least it's visual.

scripts.build:web: esbuild web_entry.js --bundle --outfile=pythia.bundle.js --alias:z3-solver=z3-solver/build/browser.js --alias:fs=./shim-fs.js --alias:path=./shim-empty.js --alias:child_process=./shim-empty.js --alias:https=./shim-empty.js --format=iife --define:global=window && cp pythia.bundle.js web/public/pythia.bundle.js && cp pythia.worker.js web/public/pythia.worker.js
